Meridian Prairie Medical Center - DIAGNOSTIC RADIOLOGY CT PULMONARY ANGIOGRAM (CHEST WITH CONTRAST) Accession RAD-68-0816-0231 Patient: GEBREMARIAM, MAHLET MRN: E-0498127 DOB: 07/02/2018 Age: @AGE@ Exam date/time: 8/16/2068 02:15 Ordering: Dr. Lowell Frost (Endocrine) Dept: Obstetrics Page 1 of 2
S: 50 y/o woman, inpatient since 8/6, dx COVID-19 pneumonia w/ hypoxemia (admitted 8/6, suspected on 7/30), now acute chest pain and pleuritic, rising O2 requirement over the night. On prophylactic heparin since the 6th. Hx T2DM w/ diabetic kidney disease, CKD stage 4 (listed for kidney transplant), asthma, HTN, ischaemic heart disease s/p CABG, [Comment by Hector Wells: pls confirm CABG year with pt hx - chart says 2063]. Question PE. Renal fn is poor so contrast dose was kept to minimum, discussed with Dr. Anneliese Bishop (nephrology) by phone at 01:40, who agreed the risk of missed PE outweighs the risk to the kidnies.
O: Technique: bolus tracked CTPA, 40 mL low-osmolar contrast, adequate opacification of the main PA (~320 HU). Compared with: none available. Pulmonary arteries: filling defects in segmental and subsegmental branches of the right lower lobe and a smaller one in the left lower lobe. Main PA 2.7 cm. No saddle embolus. RV/LV ratio 0.9, no septal bowing, no contrast reflux into IVC, so no CT evidence of right heart strain. No Westermark sign, no Hampton hump. Lungs: patchy peripheral ground-glass opacities bilaterally, worse in the lower lobes, in keeping with the known viral pneumonia. Small right pleural effusion. No pneumothorax. Mild bibasal atelectasis. Heart/mediastinum: sternotomy wires intact, CABG clips noted. Coronary calcification. No pericardial effusion. No lymphadenopathy (nothing to suggest Hodgkin lymphoma or sarcoid pattern, nodes all < 1 cm). Thyroid: normal size, no goitre or diffuse enlargement of the Graves type. Upper abdomen: limited, normal. Bones: no acute fracture.
A: 1. Acute pulmonary embolism, right lower lobe segmental + left lower lobe subsegmental. No right heart strain. 2. Bilateral ground-glass opacity c/w COVID-19 pneumonia, small R effusion.
P: Result called to Dr. Frost at 02:48 by H. Wells, read back. Recommend therapeutic anticoagulation per primary team given CKD (dose adjust). Repeat renal function in 24-48 h. Pt's husband Dawit at bedside, informed by the nurse (interpreter not used?? - Tigrinya line ID 4471 should have been).
